column3: With respect to the Connecticut MHC Portfolio Mortgage Loan (1.7%), on and after December 1, 2026, the borrowers may obtain the release of either or both of the two Mortgaged Properties identified as Westview Terrace (0.2%) or Tunnell Hill (0.2%), upon the prepayment of a release price equal to the greater of 120% of the allocated loan amount of the Mortgaged Property being released or 80% of the net sales proceeds of the Mortgaged Property being released, together with a prepayment fee equal to the greater of 1.00% of the amount prepaid and a yield maintenance premium. Such release is also conditioned upon, among other things, (i) the debt service coverage ratio following the release must be at least the greater of 1.30x and the debt service coverage ratio immediately prior to the release, (ii) the debt yield following the release must be at least the greater of 9.03% and the debt yield immediately prior to the release, (iii) the loan-to-value ratio after the release must be no greater than the lesser of the loan-to-value ratio preceding the release and 75%, and (iv) satisfaction of REMIC related conditions.
